entities.summary: Christopher Tärnström or Christoffer Tärnström was a Swedish naturalist and Lutheran pastor who was the first of the students or apostles of Carl Linnaeus who travelled to Southeast Asia where he died off Vietnam. A plant genus Ternstroemia was dedicated to him by Linnaeus.

entities.summary: Christopher Tärnström or Christoffer Tärnström was a Swedish naturalist and Lutheran pastor who was the first of the students or apostles of Carl Linnaeus who travelled to Southeast Asia where he died off Vietnam. A plant genus Ternstroemia was dedicated to him by Linnaeus.
